The Company's one of the material subsidiaries viz; Aeroflex Industries Limited entered into the capital market with its maiden initial public offering of 1,50,00,000 equity shares of Rs. 2/- each at a premium of Rs. 106/- per share aggregating to Rs. 16200/- lakhs on 22nd August, 2023. Consequent upon this, the holding of the Company including the shares held through the subsidary in AIL has been reduced to 66.99%. 7.
